sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.
The technical specification of the P max = 1.8 MW, H max = 5.5m, Q = 50m3/s, D = 3600 mm, speed = 90.58/1000 RPM,

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohamed, tested at Nag Hammadi 
Hyd. PS, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Halem: HPGC MPIS coordinator, QC 
general director.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
